description: Which of this wallet's Solana token accounts can be closed for rent, or are delegated or frozen? When to use: Before cleaning up a wallet: to learn how much rent closing its empty token accounts returns, and whether any token account has an active delegate or is frozen. Prefer another tool: To list token accounts, mints or balances (none are returned), or to check one transfer end to end (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`). Example: solana_token_hygiene {"address":"83astBRguLMdt2h5U1Tpdq5tjFoJ6noeGwaY3mDLVcri"} Paid: 0.01452 USDC or 0.0121 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.0025 EUR-denominated units (approx 400 calls per bundle) or 0.003 USD-denominated units (approx 273 calls per bundle).

address.description: Owner wallet whose token accounts are scanned: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes
